(: User
   (* (: id int)
      (: name str)))

(User 7 "Ada")

(: UserContract
   (* (: id int)
      (: name str)))

(: HistoryOptions
   (* (: mode "copy")
      (: contract UserContract)))

(: UserHistory (HistoryV1 User HistoryOptions))

(UserHistory (name: "Ada") (id: 7))

(: copied
   (* (: id int)
      (: name str)))

(<- (copied ?id ?name)
    (UserHistory ?id ?name))

(: SourceCopy
   (* (: id int)
      (: name str)))

(SourceCopy 8 "Grace")

(<- (UserHistory ?id ?name)
    (SourceCopy ?id ?name))

(: names
   (* (: name str)))

(<- (names ?name)
    (UserHistory ?name))
